subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to SharePoint file send requests

question: Is a fixed five-minute deadline acceptable for all supported MS Teams SharePoint simple uploads?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven, but choosing the maximum duration for an existing unbounded user-delivery path is a compatibility decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Accept five minutes
options.body: Land the current policy because it prevents indefinite hangs while supporting uploads substantially slower than the 30-second control-plane budget.

options.title: Increase the transfer budget
options.body: Raise only the upload-specific deadline and matching proof if supported tenant or network conditions can reasonably exceed five minutes.

recommendation.title: Accept five minutes
recommendation.body: Land the current policy because it prevents indefinite hangs while supporting uploads substantially slower than the 30-second control-plane budget.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the shared Teams drive-upload flow and is the strongest historical owner for this compatibility choice.
